subject: COI delivery sequencing & coordination for MSA + Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Sullivan <j.sullivan@stargaze.ai>, Procurement Team <procurements@stargaze.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: COI delivery sequencing & coordination for MSA + Order Form redlines

Hi Jordan / Procurement team,

Thanks for moving quickly on the paperwork. We're getting close on the MSA + Order Form, and legal asked me to confirm a clean sequence for insurance evidence so we can sign without last-minute hold-ups. A couple of asks: 

1) Can you confirm whether the Certificate of Insurance (COI) will name Redwood Inference as Additional Insured on the Commercial General Liability (CGL) and Employers Liability sections, or only on the CGL? Our standard redline asks for Additional Insured (CG 20 10 or equivalent) on CGL and a waiver of subrogation where permitted.

2) Please confirm limits on the COI: we need CGL $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate, and Professional/Errors & Omissions $2,000,000 (where applicable). If your broker requires a different schedule, please attach the broker's coverage note.

3) Sequence: we can accept a broker-issued COI + endorsement PDF before final countersignature, provided the COI references our MSA/Order Form (deal RDW-2345) and a final executed Order Form is delivered within 7 business days. If you need an exception to that sequencing, flag it here with timeline constraints.

Attached: our redline excerpt showing the insurance clauses we negotiated (MSA_insurance_excerpt_ks revisions.docx) and the current Order Form redline.

If it helps, cc'ing Marissa from Legal for quick sign-off once we have the COI/endorsement PDFs.

Next steps: please send the COI PDF + any endorsements from your broker and the broker contact. Happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if useful.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: OrderForm_Redline_v2.pdf, MSA_insurance_excerpt_ks revisions.docx

From: Jordan Sullivan <j.sullivan@stargaze.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurements@stargaze.ai>, Horizon Brokers <broker@horizonbrokers.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: COI delivery sequencing & coordination for MSA + Order Form redlines

Rachel —

Appreciate the clarity. Our broker (Horizon) confirmed they can issue the COI and the additional insured endorsement as separate PDFs today. Quick notes from their team: 

- They can name Redwood Inference as Additional Insured on the CGL only; adding Additional Insured status to Professional Liability is not standard on our policy and would require a policy amendment (likely 3–4 weeks and underwriting approval).
- Limits on the COI will reflect CGL $1MM/$2MM and E&O $2MM per your ask. Horizon will include the waiver of subrogation language where allowed in our jurisdiction.
- Broker contact is listed below for direct coordination and to provide the ACORD plus any endorsing forms.

We are attaching the COI + a draft endorsement (Stargaze_COI_20270414.pdf). We can deliver the COI/endorsement prior to countersignature and commit to final executed Order Form within five business days after you confirm acceptance of the COI and the limited Additional Insured scope. If Redwood requires Additional Insured on E&O as a hard condition to sign, we will need to log that as a follow-up item and provide a timeline.

@Horizon Brokers — can you confirm the exact endorsement form name that will appear on the COI and whether the waiver of subrogation will be recognized for Redwood?

Thanks,
Jordan Sullivan
Head of Procurement, Stargaze AI
j.sullivan@stargaze.ai

Attachments: Stargaze_COI_20270414.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: COI delivery sequencing & coordination for MSA + Order Form redlines

Rachel / Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick read of the COI + draft endorsement: 

- COI shows CGL limits at the requested levels and E&O at $2M — good.
- Endorsement language attached by Stargaze references "Additional Insured status as required by written contract" but does not name Redwood explicitly in the endorsement text. We need the endorsement to either: (a) list "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents" by name; or (b) include a reference to the MSA/Order Form by contract ID (RDW-2345) so it's clear the endorsement applies to us.
- Waiver of subrogation: endorsement indicates 'where permitted by law' — acceptable, but please confirm state of performance (Stargaze listed CA and NY) and whether broker can state 'to the fullest extent permitted by law'.
- Primary and non-contributory: our redline requires Primary & Non-Contributory language for CGL for the duration of the Order Form. The current endorsement is silent on that point. If Horizon's endorsement cannot add Primary & Non-Contributory on the CGL, we'll require a written confirmation from the broker and an execution timeline for a policy endorsement.

Recommendation (to keep momentum): accept the COI + endorsement as interim evidence provided the endorsement explicitly names Redwood or references RDW-2345 and Horizon confirms a follow-up endorsement (if needed) within 15 business days. If Stargaze insists on E&O Additional Insured as a hard condition, escalate to my team — that will require underwriting and likely delay signing.

Cc'ing Marissa for final legal sign-off once we have the naming/primary language confirmed.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Sullivan <j.sullivan@stargaze.ai>, Procurement Team <procurements@stargaze.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Horizon Brokers <broker@horizonbrokers.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: COI delivery sequencing & coordination for MSA + Order Form redlines

Jordan / Horizon —

Thanks for the prompt turnaround and for attaching the COI. We're comfortable proceeding on the interim basis described, subject to the following concrete items before we execute the Order Form: 

1) Updated endorsement that either names Redwood Inference (preferred) or references contract RDW-2345. Horizon, can you confirm whether you can re-issue the endorsement with the named insured language?
2) Confirmation from Horizon that the COI + endorsement will be followed by a binding endorsement (if necessary) within 15 business days, and a broker contact who will take responsibility for the follow-up.
3) Written confirmation on Primary & Non-Contributory status for the CGL, or a scoped remediation plan if underwriting needs extra review.

If Horizon can provide item (1) and (2) by end of day tomorrow, Legal (Marissa/Karthik) will sign off and I will share the countersigned Order Form. If we hit any of the blocker items (E&O AI requirement or inability to name Redwood), escalate and we'll review management approval for a limited exception.

Proposed timeline: Horizon confirmation by 2027-04-17 EOD -> Legal sign-off 2027-04-18 morning -> countersignature 2027-04-18 afternoon.

I'll track this in HubSpot (deal RDW-2345) and update the procurement checklist once the endorsement arrives. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
